references.phrase: category C with objects and arrows

references.context: Two morphisms with the same domain X and codomain Y, available for composition with q:Y→Q
Arrow q:Y→Q whose precomposites with the given parallel arrows are equal
For each h:Y→Z satisfying hf=hg there is exactly one u:Q→Z with h=u∘q

references.disposition: Categorical equality and composition are already part of the category axioms, not an additional algebraic equality theory.

review_rationale: Read the coequalizer universal property of a parallel pair of arrows in a category, its equality qf=qg, and unique factoring arrow from any other equalizing morphism; did not replace it with a set-theoretic quotient without category assumptions.
